Scope and freshness

The reference pages and articles show their revision date. Product pricing, usage figures and app ratings are not maintained as a live data source here; consult each product’s current official website or Shopify listing for those details.

The Markdown versions are generated with the website so that edits stay consistent across formats. The resources do not change access permissions or bypass the website’s crawler rules. Questions or corrections can be sent to penidastudio@gmail.com.
